note: Ge Hong cut into puppet parts, not depth planes. Each part gets its own pivot at the joint it hangs from. Nothing here is invented — every part is ink Wang Meng already painted, so this is displacement, not generation. pick=tight, not whole: 'whole' takes SAM's largest candidate, which is right for a depth plane and wrong for a body part — it returned four blobs filling 86-93% of their windows.

points.name: fan
points.why: the feather fan in his raised hand — a flap on a wrist, the single most legible thing to catch a breeze

points.name: sleeve
points.why: the wide pale sleeve of the raised arm, hinged at the shoulder

points.name: hem
points.why: the long skirt of the robe below the waist — the heaviest, slowest flap

points.name: head
points.why: head and cap, hinged at the neck. Tiny amplitude or it reads as a nod.
